289	          os="${MISE_INSTALL_OS:-$(get_os)}"
290	          arch="${MISE_INSTALL_ARCH:-$(get_arch)}"
291	          ext="${MISE_INSTALL_EXT:-$(get_ext)}"
292	          install_path="${MISE_INSTALL_PATH:-$HOME/.local/bin/mise}"
293	          install_dir="$(dirname "$install_path")"
294	          install_from_github="${MISE_INSTALL_FROM_GITHUB:-}"
295	
296	          # Opt-in: skip the download/install if the binary already at the install
297	          # path matches the requested version. Only the install path is checked (not
298	          # the wider PATH) so that skipping never leaves install_path missing.
299	          skip_if_exists="${MISE_INSTALL_SKIP_IF_EXISTS-}"
300	          if [ "$skip_if_exists" = "1" ] || [ "$skip_if_exists" = "true" ]; then
301	            if [ -x "$install_path" ]; then
302	              existing_version="$(installed_mise_version "$install_path")"
303	              if [ -n "$existing_version" ] && [ "$existing_version" = "$version" ]; then
304	                info "mise: $install_path is already at version $version, skipping install"
305	                return 0
306	              fi
307	            fi
308	          fi
309	          if [ "$version" != "$current_version" ] || [ "$install_from_github" = "1" ] || [ "$install_from_github" = "true" ]; then
310	            tarball_url="https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/v${version}/mise-v${version}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}"
311	          elif [ -n "${MISE_TARBALL_URL-}" ]; then
312	            tarball_url="$MISE_TARBALL_URL"
313	          else
314	            tarball_url="https://mise.jdx.dev/v${version}/mise-v${version}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}"
315	          fi
316	
317	          download_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
318	          cache_file=$(download_file "$tarball_url" "$download_dir")
319	          debug "mise-setup: tarball=$cache_file"
320	
321	          debug "validating checksum"
322	          cd "$(dirname "$cache_file")" && get_checksum "$version" "$os" "$arch" "$ext" | "$(shasum_bin)" -c >/dev/null
323	
324	          # extract tarball
325	          if [ -d "$install_path" ]; then
326	            error "MISE_INSTALL_PATH '$install_path' is a directory. Please set it to a file path, e.g. '$install_path/mise'."
327	          fi
328	          mkdir -p "$install_dir"
329	          rm -f "$install_path"
330	          extract_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
331	          cd "$extract_dir"
332	          if [ "$ext" = "tar.zst" ] && ! tar_supports_zstd; then
333	            zstd -d -c "$cache_file" | tar --no-same-owner -xf -
334	          else
335	            tar --no-same-owner -xf "$cache_file"
336	          fi
337	          if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
338	            chown 0:0 mise/bin/mise
339	            chmod 755 mise/bin/mise
340	          fi
341	          mv mise/bin/mise "$install_path"
342	
343	          # cleanup
344	          cd / # Move out of $extract_dir before removing it
345	          rm -rf "$download_dir"
346	          rm -rf "$extract_dir"
347	
348	          info "mise: installed successfully to $install_path"
349	        }
350	
351	        after_finish_help() {
352	          case "${SHELL:-}" in
353	          */zsh)
354	            info "mise: run the following to activate mise in your shell:"
355	            info "echo \"eval \\\"\\\$($install_path activate zsh)\\\"\" >> \"${ZDOTDIR-$HOME}/.zshrc\""
356	            info ""
357	            info "mise: run \`mise doctor\` to verify this is set up correctly"
358	            ;;
359	          */bash)
360	            info "mise: run the following to activate mise in your shell:"
361	            info "echo \"eval \\\"\\\$($install_path activate bash)\\\"\" >> ~/.bashrc"
362	            info ""
363	            info "mise: run \`mise doctor\` to verify this is set up correctly"
364	            ;;
365	          */fish)
366	            info "mise: run the following to activate mise in your shell:"
367	            info "echo \"$install_path activate fish | source\" >> ~/.config/fish/config.fish"
368	            info ""
369	            info "mise: run \`mise doctor\` to verify this is set up correctly"
370	            ;;
371	          *)
372	            info "mise: run \`$install_path --help\` to get started"
373	            ;;
374	          esac
375	        }
376	
377	        install_mise
378	        if [ "${MISE_INSTALL_HELP-}" != 0 ]; then
379	          after_finish_help
380	        fi
381	
382	        cd -- "$initial_working_dir"
383	    }
384	    local MISE_INSTALL_HELP=0
385	    test -f "$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" || install
386	}
387	__mise_bootstrap
388	exec -a "$0" "$MISE_INSTALL_PATH" "$@"
